# Carnegie Classification of Institutions of Higher Education

> > The official Carnegie Classification system for categorizing institutions of higher education, including the Leadership for Public Purpose elective classification.

Managed by the American Council on Education, this site provides information about the Carnegie Classification framework, with particular focus on the Leadership for Public Purpose (LPP) Classification. The site serves institutions seeking classification, offering application guidance, eligibility requirements, and engagement resources.

## Key Topics

- Carnegie Classification of Institutions of Higher Education
- Leadership for Public Purpose Classification
- LPP Classification
- Elective classifications
- Leadership development
- Higher education leadership
- Application eligibility requirements
- Branch campus policy
- GivePulse platform
- The Carnegie Foundation for the Advancement of Teaching
- Doerr Institute for New Leaders
- Rice University
- HigherLed

- [Leadership for Public Purpose Classification Frequently Asked Questions](https://carnegieclassifications.acenet.edu/elective-classifications/leadership-about/faq): FAQ for Leadership for Public Purpose Classification eligibility & process
